# Export a report

## Before you start

You need read access to the project. Exported reports are encrypted at rest.

## Steps

1. Open the project and select **Reports**.
2. Select **Export**. When the download finishes, open the CSV file.

Clients MUST retain the receipt unless the user cancels the export.
Clients SHOULD retry failed downloads, except when access has been revoked.

## Delete a report

Warning: Deletion is permanent.

1. Select the report.
2. Select **Delete**.

Warning: Deletion is permanent. Confirm only if you no longer need the report.
